name: Muslim American Youth Foundation
mission: Our mission is to educate, enrich, and enlighten young Muslim-Americans with the tools they need to thrive—in their communities and within the broader American society.
theoryOfChange: The Muslim American Youth Foundation (MAYF) outlines its strategic approach under the 'Our Strategy' section on its 'About Us' page and further elaborates on its programs. This framework details how their programs in learning, athletics, and fostering success are designed to help youth develop a strong sense of personal, academic, and spiritual identity, and equip them with skills and knowledge to overcome challenges. Their purpose is further described through initiatives in outreach, advocacy, education, youth empowerment, resource dissemination, and community service, all aimed at fostering personal growth and providing holistic support to Muslim-American youth.

In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="2">$2,087,958 in total revenue</cite> to support its mission of creating a dedicated facility for youth enlightenment. A significant portion of its funding comes from <cite id="2">contributions totaling $1,502,397</cite>, supplemented by <cite id="2">$225,128 in program service revenue</cite>. While the organization demonstrates a <cite id="2">strong 3-year revenue growth rate of 38.7%</cite>, it maintains a <cite id="1">program expense ratio of 72.1%</cite> based on its most recent filings. This ratio indicates that a substantial portion of funds is directed toward administrative and fundraising needs as the organization scales its infrastructure. Despite this, MAYF shows high operational efficiency in its development efforts, <cite id="1">spending only $0.03 to raise every $1</cite>. The foundation's work spans several critical areas, including <cite id="3">youth sports, athletics mentoring, and health advocacy</cite>, providing a vital safe space for underserved populations.
